description_en: Query the current statistics information of a job
description_zh: 查询任务当前的统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun openitag get-task-statistics --tenant-id GAR000134 --task-id 1540002518306500608 --stat-type ITEM --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTaskStatistics

parameters.description_en: Tenant ID. For more information about how to obtain a tenant ID, see [ListTenants](~~454649~~).
parameters.help_en: Tenant ID. For more information about how to obtain a tenant ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454649.html
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.description_en: Job ID. For more information about how to obtain a job ID, see [ListTasks](~~454662~~).
parameters.description_zh: 任务ID。如何获取任务ID，请参见[ListTasks](~~454662~~)。
parameters.help_en: Job ID. For more information about how to obtain a job ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454662.html
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.description_en:

- ITEM: Single item.
